title: Phenotyping and quantifying mycobacteria-specific myeloid cells by mass cytometry
author: Kiravu, Rozot, et al.

steps.title: Prepare Mtb lysate antigen
steps.instruction: Make a 2 mg/mL stock from lyophilized protein, then a 150 µg/mL working stock and store aliquots at –80 °C.

substeps.instruction: Allow the vial (10 mg) to reach 18‑24 °C and add 5 mL sterile 1× PBS; vortex 20–30 s to dissolve.
Prepare working stock 150 µg/mL by mixing 0.5 mL of the 2 mg/mL stock with 6.67 mL sterile PBS.
Aliquot 100 µL into tubes and freeze at –80 °C until use.

steps.title: Prepare BCG antigen
steps.instruction: Resuspend BCG vaccine to ~10 × 10⁶ CFU/mL on the day of use.

substeps.instruction: In a biosafety cabinet, spray and wipe the unopened vial and the 20 mm crimper with 70 % ethanol.
Add 500 µL stimulation media to the vial to achieve the target CFU concentration.
Replace the rubber cap, invert the vial and vortex for 1 min to ensure full resuspension.

steps.title: Conjugate antibodies in‑house
steps.instruction: Label antibodies with lanthanide or cadmium isotopes using the MaxPar antibody labeling kit (average recoveries: 54 % lanthanide, 89 % cadmium).

steps.title: Titrate antibodies
steps.instruction: Generate two‑fold serial dilutions starting at 2 µg per 100 µL across seven concentrations and select the lowest concentration giving maximal signal‑to‑noise.

steps.title: Harvest BAL cells
steps.instruction: Collect cells from stimulation tubes, wash, and centrifuge as described.

substeps.instruction: Label 5 mL snap‑cap FACS tubes with sample ID and condition.
Remove Sarstedt stimulation tubes from 4 °C and place on ice.
Add 1.2 mL cold 1× barium‑free PBS containing 2.5 mM EDTA to each tube.
Mix gently with a sterile pipette, keep tubes on ice for 15 min.
Using a single sterile Pasteur pipette, aspirate supernatant from each donor in the order: unstained, unstimulated, stimulated, leaving ~50 µL in each tube.
Transfer the cell suspension to the corresponding labeled 5 mL FACS tubes.
Wash the original stimulation tubes with 1 mL cold 1× PBS and transfer the wash to the same labeled tube.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min at 18‑24 °C.
Aspirate supernatant with a sterile Pasteur pipette.
Add 2 mL 1× barium‑free PBS, repeat centrifugation and aspiration.
Tap tubes to resuspend the cell pellet.

steps.title: Viability staining (Cell‑ID Intercalator‑Rh)
steps.instruction: Stain cells with Rh103, then wash twice.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a 0.5–1 µM Cell‑ID Intercalator‑Rh (Rh103) working solution by diluting the 500 µM stock in 1× barium‑free PBS.
Add 1 mL Rh103 solution to each experimental tube (exclude the unstained control).
Mix well with a P1000 pipette (filtered tip) and incubate 20 min at 18‑24 °C.
Add 2 mL MaxPar cell staining buffer to each tube.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min at 18‑24 °C.
Aspirate supernatant with a sterile Pasteur pipette.
Repeat the buffer addition and centrifugation for a total of two washes.

steps.title: Chemokine receptor staining
steps.instruction: Add chemokine receptor cocktail, incubate, and wash twice.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate supernatant leaving ~50 µL of buffer in each tube.
Tap tubes to resuspend cells.
Add 50 µL chemokine receptor cocktail to each experimental tube (exclude unstained control).
Mix with a P100 pipette (filtered tip) and incubate 30 min in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator.
Add 2 mL MaxPar cell staining buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min at 18‑24 °C.
Aspirate supernatant with a sterile Pasteur pipette.
Repeat buffer addition and centrifugation for a total of two washes.

steps.title: Surface marker staining
steps.instruction: Add surface antibody cocktail, incubate, and wash twice.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate supernatant leaving ~50 µL of buffer.
Tap tubes to resuspend cells.
Add 50 µL surface antibody cocktail (prepared in MaxPar staining buffer) to each experimental tube (exclude unstained control).
Mix with a new P100 pipette tip for each tube.
Incubate 30 min at 18‑24 °C.
Add 2 mL MaxPar cell staining buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 10 min at 18‑24 °C.
Aspirate supernatant with a sterile Pasteur pipette.
Repeat buffer addition and centrifugation for a total of two washes.

steps.title: Fixation and permeabilization
steps.instruction: Fix cells with MaxPar Fix I, then permeabilize with Perm S and wash twice.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate supernatant leaving ~50 µL of buffer.
Gently tap tubes to resuspend cells.
Add 1 mL 1× MaxPar Fix I (diluted in 1× barium‑free PBS) to each tube.
Mix with a P1000 pipette (filtered tip).
Incubate 20 min at 18‑24 °C.
Add 2 mL MaxPar Perm S buffer.
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 5 min at 18‑24 °C.
Aspirate supernatant with a sterile Pasteur pipette.
Repeat the Perm S wash (add buffer, centrifuge) for a total of two washes.

steps.title: Intracellular cytokine staining
steps.instruction: Add intracellular cytokine cocktail, incubate, and wash twice.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate the last Perm S wash leaving approximately 50 µL of buffer.
Add 50 µL intracellular cytokine cocktail (prepared in MaxPar Perm S buffer) to each experimental tube (exclude unstained control).
Mix with a P100 pipette (filtered tip).
Incubate 30 min at 18‑24 °C.
Add 2 mL MaxPar cell staining buffer.
Centrifuge at 800 × g for 5 min at 18‑24 °C.
Aspirate supernatant with a sterile Pasteur pipette.
Repeat the buffer wash for a total of two washes.

steps.title: Iridium intercalator staining
steps.instruction: Stain DNA with Ir191/193, then store overnight at 4 °C or incubate 1 h at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate supernatant leaving ~50 µL of buffer.
Tap tubes to resuspend cells.
Prepare a 1:1000 dilution of Ir191/193 in MaxPar Fix and Perm buffer.
Add 0.5 mL of the diluted Ir191/193 solution to each tube.
Vortex briefly.
Store tubes at 4 °C overnight, or incubate for 1 h at 18‑24 °C.
